title: 1987 Topps #402 Mike Trujillo Seattle Mariners Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1987 Topps trading card featuring Mike Trujillo of the Seattle Mariners. It is card number 402 from the set and was manufactured by Topps in 1987. The card is a sports trading card from the MLB league, specifically for baseball. The card is not autographed and is part of a collection of sports trading cards.
